name: nextiq-chat
description: Chat UI for NextIQ backed by the Thrio prediction API.

scripts.deploy:staging: node --check server.js && gcloud functions deploy nextiq-staging --project=voicebot-451222 --region=us-central1 --gen2 --runtime=nodejs22 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --entry-point=nextiq --source=. --set-env-vars=FIRESTORE_PREFIX=staging,LOG_EXECUTION_ID=true,THRIO_KB_ID=69b7c1301d31ed595dfef3cb --set-secrets=THRIO_AUTH_TOKEN=nextiq-staging-thrio-auth-token:latest,ADMIN_PASSWORD=nextiq-staging-admin-password:latest,ENCRYPTION_SALT=nextiq-staging-encryption-salt:latest,CAMPAIGN_ENCRYPTION_SECRET=nextiq-staging-campaign-encryption-secret:latest --timeout=300 --concurrency=10 --max-instances=200 --cpu=1 --memory=512Mi --service-account=nextiq-runtime@voicebot-451222.iam.gserviceaccount.com
scripts.deploy:production: node --check server.js && gcloud functions deploy nextiq --project=voicebot-451222 --region=us-central1 --gen2 --runtime=nodejs22 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --entry-point=nextiq --source=. --set-env-vars=FIRESTORE_PREFIX=nextiq,LOG_EXECUTION_ID=false,THRIO_KB_ID=69b7c1301d31ed595dfef3cb --set-secrets=THRIO_AUTH_TOKEN=nextiq-production-thrio-auth-token:latest,ADMIN_PASSWORD=nextiq-production-admin-password:latest,ENCRYPTION_SALT=nextiq-production-encryption-salt:latest,CAMPAIGN_ENCRYPTION_SECRET=nextiq-production-campaign-encryption-secret:latest --timeout=300 --concurrency=10 --max-instances=200 --cpu=1 --memory=512Mi --service-account=nextiq-runtime@voicebot-451222.iam.gserviceaccount.com
scripts.deploy:demo: node --check server.js && gcloud functions deploy nextiq-demo --project=voicebot-451222 --region=us-central1 --gen2 --runtime=nodejs22 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --entry-point=nextiq --source=. --set-env-vars=FIRESTORE_PREFIX=demo,LOG_EXECUTION_ID=false,THRIO_KB_ID=69b7c1301d31ed595dfef3cb --set-secrets=THRIO_AUTH_TOKEN=nextiq-demo-thrio-auth-token:latest,ADMIN_PASSWORD=nextiq-demo-admin-password:latest,ENCRYPTION_SALT=nextiq-demo-encryption-salt:latest,CAMPAIGN_ENCRYPTION_SECRET=nextiq-demo-campaign-encryption-secret:latest --timeout=300 --concurrency=10 --max-instances=200 --cpu=1 --memory=512Mi --service-account=nextiq-runtime@voicebot-451222.iam.gserviceaccount.com
